Life Insurance Crash Course

COVERAGE, SIMPLIFIED

What your agent should've explained the first time.

Term Life Insurance

Pick a window of coverage. Lock in your rate. Your family is protected for the years that matter most.

Whole Life Insurance

Permanent coverage that doubles as a savings vehicle. Premiums stay the same, cash value grows tax-deferred, and it's yours for life.

Final Expense Insurance

Your family shouldn't be scrambling to cover funeral costs and medical bills. This handles it. $5K to $50K, simplified process, eligible through age 89.

IUL (Indexed Universal Life)

Coverage plus a wealth-building component. Cash value grows with the market but is protected from losses. You participate in the gains and skip the drops.

Advanced Resources

BEYOND LIFE INSURANCE

What your financial advisor forgot to teach you.

Retirement & Annuities

Income you can't outlive. Built for people who want a guaranteed paycheck in retirement, not a guessing game.

Debt Elimination

Pay off debt faster using assets you already have. No lifestyle changes. No gimmicks. Just math.

Long Term Care

The average nursing home stay costs over $100K a year. This makes sure that bill doesn't land on your family.

Estate Planning

Make sure your money goes where you want it to. Not to the IRS. Not to probate court. To your family.

Living Trusts

Probate is expensive, public, and slow. A living trust avoids all three while giving you full control.

Defined Benefit Plans

If you own a business or earn well above average, this lets you put away significantly more than a 401(k) allows. Built for high earners.
